svg.title: Red White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, standardized vivid colours. Observed red figure and two white leaf-like slashes; contour approximate. Distinct from SFMOMA 66.3 and Foundation EK 290.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/FC.566/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
